title: If UPI Is Free, Who Pays for It? | PhonePe, Razorpay & NPCI | WTF is Payments?

segments.title: History of Money & Panel Introductions
segments.narrator_bridge: Welcome to WTF is Payments. Nikhil Kamath sits down with the architects of India's digital payment revolution: Sohini Rajola of NPCI, Harshil Mathur of Razorpay, and Sameer Nigam of PhonePe.

segments.title: Inside NPCI: Section 8 Structure, Surplus & Enforcement Power
segments.narrator_bridge: To understand UPI, we start with NPCI. Sohini Rajola explains its non-profit Section 8 structure and why banks originally resisted building it.

segments.title: Why Indian Payments Banks Failed While Small Finance Banks Survived
segments.narrator_bridge: The panel turns to payment banks, examining why restricting credit lending doomed the original model.

segments.title: Flipkart's Big Billion Day Meltdown & The Birth of PhonePe
segments.narrator_bridge: Sameer Nigam recounts the early infrastructure crisis at Flipkart that led to the creation of PhonePe.

segments.title: Anatomy of a 100-Rupee UPI Transfer & Who Actually Pays for It
segments.narrator_bridge: Now to the core question: when you send 100 rupees over UPI, who actually pays the server costs? The panel breaks down the exact unit economics.

segments.title: The Zero-MDR Debate & The 30% UPI Market-Share Cap
segments.narrator_bridge: Next, the controversial Zero-MDR mandate and the regulatory headache over PhonePe and Google Pay's combined 85 percent market dominance.

segments.title: Credit Card MDR Splits, RuPay on UPI & Razorpay's 10-Bps Margin
segments.narrator_bridge: Harshil Mathur unpacks credit card interchange, Razorpay's paper-thin 10-basis-point margin, and how RuPay on UPI changes merchant economics.

segments.title: What Payment Data Reveals About India & Solving Cash-on-Delivery Trust
segments.narrator_bridge: Looking at macro transaction trends, the founders discuss consumer behavior and how digital trust finally displaced Cash on Delivery.

segments.title: B2B Payments, Stablecoins vs. RBI CBDCs & Agentic Commerce
segments.narrator_bridge: Moving to future horizons: the reality of B2B invoicing friction, stablecoin settlements versus central bank digital currencies, and AI agents transacting.

segments.title: Emerging Builders: Wearable Rings, Merchant of Record & Cross-Border PSR
segments.narrator_bridge: Four emerging fintech founders join the table to demo smart payment rings, merchant-of-record rails, and cross-border settlement.

segments.title: Rogue AI Agents, 99.99% AI-Written Code & Final Advice for Founders
segments.narrator_bridge: To close, Nikhil and the panel debate the risks of autonomous AI agents executing financial transactions and share hard-earned advice for founders.
